name: Nakaza Romi
source: Although she just transferred to the school in April, she transformed the dance club from a cheerleading-focused club to an idol activities club. From baton twirling to hip-hop, she is a master of all things dance. With an unyielding spirit, she possesses great confidence in herself. She is not satisfied unless she gets what she wants.
